correctness.rationale: By Lemma 2.2 graph Čech scale two is nerve of closed radius-one graph balls. J(6,3) has 20 vertices, and each N[v] consists of 10 triples meeting v in at least two elements. Independently enumerated all 16140 faces, exact dimension f-vector (20,180,960,2850,4500,4110,2400,900,200,20), and greedily matched 8049 pairs with 41 remaining critical cells: one 0-cell, eleven 3-cells and thirty 4-cells. Independently topologically sorted all 87800 Hasse cover relations (all 16140 nodes), certifying acyclicity; exact signed integer recursive Morse reduction gave ZERO on all 30 critical 4-to-3 columns. Therefore Morse CW has 3-skeleton wedge eleven S3, and each 4-cell maps by an element of π3(∨11 S3)=Z^11 measured by zero integral boundary; all 30 attach trivially. This yields integral wedge eleven S3 plus thirty S4. This is a full finite certificate of the exact 20-vertex complex, not an infinite-family inference.
residual_risks: Exact finite homotopy deduction relies on the inspected acyclic matching and integer attaching-map chain/cup calculations, not only field Betti numbers.
